regime: Risk-On Equity Extension, Gold Flips Down, Crude Rolls Lower
summary: The risk-on move accelerated. NQ ripped 2.74 percent to 30,782, cleared the 30,000 wall and ran toward 31,000. ES added 1.34 percent to 7,829. Both closed near their highs above rising stops. The tell was rotation: gold and crude both sold off. December gold fell 0.79 percent to 4,381 and flipped its trend stop down. Crude, now on the November contract after the roll, dropped 3.66 percent to 92.00 and stayed below its falling stop. VIX near 14.8, calm. Money moved out of metals and energy and into stocks.

risk.sizing: Standard, with an extended-move caveat. NQ is up two strong sessions into 31,000, so keep size honest and favor pullbacks over chasing highs.
risk.openRisk: NQ and ES carry a with-trend long lean above their rising stops (30,588 / 7,809). December gold carries a with-trend short lean below its 4,419 flipped stop and November crude below its 93.66 falling stop.
risk.note: Throttle NORMAL. Fed event risk is behind us and the indexes extended a second day, but the move is stretched into the 31,000 wall. Step to REDUCED if VIX pushes back toward the high teens or the indexes lose their rising stops on 2 closes. The flash PMIs Wednesday are the next data window. Not financial advice.

psychology: Rotation days test discipline more than clean trend days. NQ is up two strong sessions and just tagged 30,863 under the 31,000 wall, so chasing the highs is where accounts get hurt. Let price come back to the rising stop and prove buyers are still there. And watch gold: a leader Friday, it flipped its stop down today. A strong market one day can be the laggard the next. Trade the level in front of you, keep size honest, and let the trend earn your entry.
